api_method_source: Remote OK public API — the documented surface is a single endpoint, GET https://remoteok.com/api (returns a JSON array; first element is a legal/attribution notice; optional ?tags=<tag> query filter). Enumerated by inspecting https://remoteok.com/api and the Remote OK API note, fetched 2026-07-18. There is no OpenAPI/Postman/llms.txt; this is the complete public surface.
coverage_note: The single GET /api endpoint is fully wrapped by the read-only `jobs` resource: `jobs list` (feed + client-side --tag/--tags/--search/--company/--min-salary/--limit, with ?tags= as a server-side payload optimization) and `jobs get <id>` (select-by-id over the feed, since Remote OK has no per-id endpoint). Remote OK is unauthenticated and read-only — there are no write verbs to add.
